builtins.name: The Crew Motorfest
builtins.summary: L2 stiffens and chatters when slammed; R2 is free with a hard kick on every shift.

builtins.name: Forza Horizon 5
builtins.summary: Uses live car data: real ABS lock-up, a kick on every gear change, wheelspin buzz.

builtins.name: Forza Motorsport
builtins.summary: Sim-style: a firm wall on L2, light weight on R2, redline and wheelspin cues.

builtins.name: F1 25
builtins.summary: Live F1 data: brake lock-up chatter, a kick on every upshift, a buzz on the rev lights.

builtins.name: DiRT Rally 2.0
builtins.summary: Codemasters data (also DiRT 4 and GRID): loose-surface wheelspin, lock-ups and shift kicks.

builtins.name: BeamNG.drive
builtins.summary: OutGauge data (also Live for Speed): ABS and traction-control lights drive the triggers.

builtins.name: Rainbow Six Siege
builtins.summary: Light aim weight on L2, a click wall on R2, and recoil kicks driven by the game's own rumble.

builtins.name: Shooter
builtins.summary: Light weight on aim, a crisp click-through wall on the trigger.

builtins.name: Off
builtins.summary: Triggers feel like a normal controller.
